R: Slashed hallucination rate from 12% to 0.7% and improved user trust score to 98%.

star_interview_defense.question: Describe a scenario where a machine learning model performed well in offline tests but degraded in production.
star_interview_defense.trap: Not understanding training-serving skew or temporal leakage.
star_interview_defense.model_defense: S: Our fraud detection model achieved 97% precision in offline validation but dropped to 68% precision within 2 weeks of production launch.
